name: Contoso Data Studio
product_goal: Generate realistic business data and build/inspect a complete local analytics data platform around DuckDB/DuckLake and dbt.

current_state.generator: separate Contoso generator repository already exists
current_state.migration_source: Datapass contains reusable dbt/model/chart assets that should be extracted rather than rewritten blindly.

owns: dbt Charts or equivalent bounded result visualization
Parquet/JSON/CSV/Excel viewers and data profiling where useful

dbt_rule: Business calculations and KPIs belong in SQL/dbt models. Charts visualize outputs; charts are not the primary calculation engine.

motherduck.rule: Contoso must remain fully useful in local DuckDB/DuckLake mode. MotherDuck may become an explicit cloud execution/storage option, never a hidden dependency.

reusable_assets_to_extract_from_datapass: dbt Core runner and dbt-duckdb integration
chart resources and dbt Charts interoperability
